title: leggedrobotics/pace-sim2real
abstract:
PACE: A systematic approach for sim-to-real transfer of legged robots, identifying actuator and joint dynamics with standard joint encoders.

# ⚙️ PACE — Sim-to-Real Transfer for Legged Robots PACE is a framework for **sim-to-real transfer of diverse robotic systems**, combining data-driven system identification with evolutionary optimization. It enables accurate actuator modeling and robust adaptation between simulation to reality by explicitly learning physically meaningful dynamics parameters. --- ## 🤖🐾 What is PACE? PACE (Precise Adaptation through Continuous Evolution) bridges the gap between simulation and real hardware by: * Estimating actuator and joint dynamics directly from measured data * Using CMA-ES for parameter optimization * Applying learned parameters to improve sim-to-real locomotion performance * Supporting multiple robot platforms and actuator types It is designed to integrate seamlessly with **NVIDIA Isaac Lab** and follows its task and environment conventions. --- ## 📦 Installation ### 1. Install Isaac Lab Follow the official Isaac Lab installation guide: [https://isaac-sim.github.io/IsaacLab/main/source/setup/installation/index.html](https://isaac-sim.github.io/IsaacLab/main/source/setup/installation/index.html) We recommend using the **conda** or **uv** installation method, as this simplifies running Python scripts from the terminal and managing dependencies. ### 2. Clone this repository Clone or copy this project separately from the Isaac Lab installation (i.e. outside the `IsaacLab` directory): ### 3. Install PACE in editable mode Using a Python interpreter that has Isaac Lab installed: ### ⚠️ Isaac Sim version compatibility PACE is developed and tested against **Isaac Sim 5.0 / Isaac Lab (latest)**. # 一、动机

> 解决了腿足机器人仿真到现实迁移中执行器和关节动力学建模不准确的问题，仅凭标准关节编码器即可完成系统辨识。


# 二、方法

> PACE框架通过数据驱动系统辨识与CMA-ES进化优化，显式学习具有物理意义的动力学参数，并集成到NVIDIA Isaac Lab中用于sim-to-real迁移。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 在多种机器人平台上提升了sim-to-real运动性能，但原文未报告具体数值，仅定性说明有效。


# 四、对我的启发

> 可借鉴其将系统辨识与进化优化结合的思路，用于其他机器人迁移任务；具体实验数据需进一步查阅原文。
